notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
Manual Gear will be available, and leaderboards will reflect if the player got the best time on manual/automatic.
A speedometer will be added to the UI, replacing the old bar. Manual drivers will have a bigger UI graphic to check speed and revs to decide, and automatic will have an easier to check element while driving.
Addition to a friends list in-game, so you can have up to 25 drivers you want to keep an eye on 👀 .
Leaderboards will be revamped. Besides reflecting the type of gear the driver used, you will be able to filter through different settings: Your global position, top 10 and friends.

notes.title: Precision & Chase
notes.content:
NEW UPDATE 9.9.2025Precision & Chase

[previewyoutube="CwYAgcSMzWA;full"][/previewyoutube]
Precision: from almost the very beginning, many players asked us to add manual gear shifting. We’ve done it, designed especially for those who are looking for a more technical and skill-based challenge. 

Chase: you can create a custom list with up to 25 drivers to directly compare your times against theirs. You can challenge your friends or even strangers as long as they appear on the current leaderboard.

notes.title: Rally Arcade Classics to expand with the Precision & Chase update on September 9
notes.content: Need more rally games? Rally Arcade Classics looks like a good one and it's expanding with a free update on September 9th.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/rally-arcade-classics-to-expand-with-the-precision-chase-update-on-september-9/

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.content:
In this Rally Arcade Classics DEMO you can try 4 modes of the main game:

- Time Attack (Finish the stage in the shortest time possible in the Finland stage)

- VS (Race against another driver on a paved section of Catalonia)

- DRIFT (Achieve maximum points by drifting on the rocky roads of Greece)

- RACE (Race against 4 drivers through the narrow curves of Monte Carlo)

notes.title: Wheel compatibility
notes.content:
Added the following wheels compatibility:

-- Thrustmaster T300RS
-- Logitech  G29

If your wheel doesn't work, please install this package from Microsoft:

https://support.microsoft.com/es-es/topic/actualizaci%C3%B3n-para-visual-c-2013-y-visual-c-redistributable-paquete-5b2ac5ab-4139-8acc-08e2-9578ec9b2cf1

And then install the Logitech HUB from:
https://www.logitechg.com/es-es/innovation/g-hub.html

IMPORTANT: You need to install the Logitech HUB always, to use all wheels on the list.
